$note: A Semi style: the look every component reads. tokens = shape, card border, fonts, control sizes; semantic = the neutral colours the style sets (both themes); omitted = the shared neutrals of tokens/tokens.json.
name: Flat
description: Cool neutral greys, thin borders, no card shadows, medium radii, compact 34px controls, Geist. Dense, information-first screens: dashboards, tools, admin.

radius-chip.note: Small marks: checkboxes, inline code, count marks

radius-control.note: Buttons, inputs, selects, tiles, list rows

font-sans.value: var(--font-sans-family, var(--font-geist)), Geist, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", sans-serif

spacing-control.note: Toolbar controls: buttons, pills, chips, search (h-control, w-control)
